primary.claim: PRIMARY (owner hypothesis): a label-free collapse coordinate predicts model differences beyond accuracy, the head and the constant

secondary.family: T2 secondaries, Holm over the items with a p-value (alpha 0.05)

S-PL.what: the PRIMARY rule with log10 nc1_train (labelled) as the collapse coordinate (T1 MP-9a)
S-PL.claim: PRIMARY (owner hypothesis): a label-free collapse coordinate predicts model differences beyond accuracy, the head and the constant
S-PL.p_statistic: -mean MAE ratio (acc_nc1 / best rival) over the evaluable outcomes

M-DO3.what: mechanism: the committed AH-1 law |FPR - (0.0224 - 0.1080 log10 nc1_train)| <= 0.035 in >= 75% of C units (T1 X4-2M, T3 CZ-1, T2 P1 demoted)

info_CZ7c.note: Hui et al.'s mechanism for DO-3 (INFO)

M-LF.what: mechanism: the label-free coordinate chosen on D21 ranks the C units' train-referenced false alarm (oriented rho >= 0.7) better than every head coordinate and accuracy (T3 CZ-2 / CZ-7a, T1 MP-2)

MP1.what: rho(log10 nc1_train, train-referenced density false alarm) <= -0.6 (T1 MP-1)

MP3.what: rho(log10 nc1_train, margin - d1 lead) >= +0.6 (T1 MP-3 on the discovered coordinate, T1 review D1)

MP5.what: rho(log10 nc1_train, AUROC(logit gap) - AUROC(MSP) on clean errors) <= -0.5 (MSP saturation, T1 MP-5)

MP6.what: rho(log10 nc1_train, SVHN AUROC of the penult L2 10-NN) <= -0.5 (T1 MP-6)

MP7.what: rho(log10 nc1_test / nc1_train, clean ECE) >= +0.5 (T1 MP-7)

P2b.what: the train-test collapse gap log10(nc1_tetr / nc1_train) orders the over-alarm (Hui et al. 2022)

M-NC4.what: mechanism: rho(1 - held-out NC4 agreement, O1) >= 0.5 (T3 CZ-3 / CZ-7b)

FE1.what: family-demeaned twin of MP1 (T1 review D4): dir * rho_fam >= 0.6

FE3.what: family-demeaned twin of MP3 (T1 review D4): dir * rho_fam >= 0.6

FE9.what: family-demeaned twin of the PRIMARY: rho_fam(pred acc_coll, y) >= 0.6 in >= 3 of the evaluable outcomes (T1 review D4)

P3a.what: margin - d1 lead (all-errors AUROC, train centres, clean rows 0-4999) falls as collapse deepens

P4.what: SVHN: L2-normalised 10-NN AUROC - best head AUROC rises with collapse (Harun et al. 2025)

P5a.what: harm slope (pt of paired accuracy loss per unit H) falls with collapse

P5b.what: H10 (the HOLD-band edge) rises with collapse

P6b.what: best non-duplicate tap - best head statistic, per-sample corrupt vs clean (s1, s3), rises with collapse

S7.what: overconfidence under shift (mean MSP - accuracy, 30 discovery splits) rises with collapse

P3b.what: at a penult as collapsed as a full-fit resnet56 (plnc1 <= theta frozen on D), the centre margin adds nothing beyond the head statistic picked on rows A: every such C unit d <= +0.005; REFUTED if any has its 99% CI above 0 (a bound rule; no p-value)
P3b.reading: centre geometry adds beyond the picked head statistic at a collapsed penult on these units

P5c.what: the committed HOLD band (AH-2(b): H <= 0.25 -> cost <= 8 pt) has no violation over the 30 discovery splits in >= n - 2 C units (a bound rule; no p-value)

IC-P2.what: instrument check: the held-out-calibrated conformal false alarm (cal rows A, test rows B, alpha 0.05) is inside the exact 99% beta-binomial band in >= n - 1 C units (no p-value: an instrument check)

P7.what: blind collapse ordering registered at P1 (experiments/b4/prereg_p7.json): Kendall tau(order, nc1_train) <= -0.66 in >= 4 families

P8.what: label-free tracks labelled: |log10(plnc1 / nc1_test)| <= 0.1 in >= 10/12 C units AND rho(log10 g_cv, log10 nc1_test) <= -0.8 (T1 review D5 form of MP-8; p = max of the two, intersection-union)

MP-K.what: knob pairs (label smoothing, weight decay) x 5 outcomes: the frozen acc + collapse law predicts the change of the outcome better than the accuracy-only law in >= 75% of the cells (15 of 20); a pair with |delta acc| > 0.5 pt is INFO
MP-K.p_note: binomial tail under win probability 1/2 per cell (cells of one pair share its baseline)

MP4.note: T1 MP-4 is noise-limited (T1 review D5): INFO
